title: TurboTax Return Refund Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=turbotax:return refund_usd=*
| stats sum(refund_usd) as total_value, avg(refund_usd) as avg_value by filing_status
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks filing status values by total and average refund amount across TurboTax return events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `refund_usd` values for each TurboTax return event and review total and average refund amount by filing status.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total refund amount.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which filing status shows the biggest refund amount numbers in your TurboTax return data.
